title: 17 pieces of feedback from colleagues in four countries
summary: Colleagues and leaders in four countries wrote about how I coached teams, paired with developers and kept tricky situations calm.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a recognition event, not an intervention.
the_call: Ask for feedback from every business and program I worked with, beyond my own team.
what_i_did: Requested feedback from the SaaS, DevOps, graduate program and business teams I supported.
what_changed: 17 responses in the year, 15 of them in the last quarter; a senior leader called me a wonderful technical coach, and another leader cited my drive for quality when hiring a DevOps scrum team.

quotes.text: You are very level-headed and approach every situation with a calm and reassuring manner. This helps put people at ease and diffuse tricky situations.
Thanks Datta for being a wonderful technical coach and able to articulate complex concepts with relative ease.
